normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two stone slabs between the workshops.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the doorway to push Morgan out of the threshold, places a new oak door in Riley’s doorway, picks up the dumped tools and returns them into Riley’s chest, reattaches the item frame and places the iron pickaxe back in it, then places stone slabs along the threshold to keep the access open
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the shared chest to the observer line, looks toward Riley’s workshop, briefly toggles the signal lamp on and off once, then remains standing at the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves swiftly to Riley’s workshop entrance, places a solid block two squares in front of the doorway to create space, picks up the dropped tools, returns them into Riley’s chest, places a temporary fence gate in the doorway, then walks to the signal lamp and toggles it on, off, and on again.

target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward to increase distance, turns slightly toward the open workshop lane, and side-steps along the inner wall toward the stall’s rear corner with hands empty and gaze low, then pauses facing the lane to watch for a clear path out.
